name: Cloud Controls Matrix
description: CCM v4.1.0 — the first v4.1 release, superseded by 4.1.1. 207 controls across 17 domains (v4.0 had 197; the IVS domain became I&S, Infrastructure Security). Shipped without cross-framework mappings: its Scope Applicability (Mappings) sheet reads only "This dataset is not available yet". Control IDs carry over to 4.1.1 unchanged.
relationToCloudSecurity: Cloud-security controls framework, superseded by CCM 4.1.1. Retained because anything written against CSA's "v4.1" download between January and October 2026 used the 4.1.0 text.
relationToAISecurity: Cloud-platform controls foundation; AI-specific controls in AICM.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Confirm specific document license on download page.

lifecycle.notes:
SUPERSEDED BY 4.1.1, which CSA shipped inside the same "CCM v4.1" bundle without changing the artifact page, its version label, or its stated release date — so this directory and ../4.1.1/ are both branded "CCM v4.1" upstream. Control IDs are stable between the two: a 4.1.0 reference migrates to 4.1.1 by string match.

Published 2026-01-27 per CSA's artifact page ("CCM v4.1 … Released: 01/27/2026", https://cloudsecurityalliance.org/artifacts/cloud-controls-matrix-v4-1). Dates considered and not used: 2025-11-01, the "CCM v4.1.0" row of the workbook's own Change Log; and 2026-01-13, the generated_at token in the workbook filename.

CSA's v4.1 download no longer serves this workbook: since the bundle was repacked on 2026-10-06 it contains CCMv4.1.1-generated_at_2026_10_02.xlsx instead. The 4.1.0 workbook is archived in S3 at this directory's path.

current_extraction.notes: Parsed from CCMv4.1.0-generated_at_2026_01_13.xlsx (gitignored; archived to S3 2026-10-23). 207 controls, each with implementation guidelines, auditing guidelines, ownership and relevance grids, and its embedded CAIQ questions. Re-running scripts/parse_ccm.py against that workbook reproduces ccm-4.1.0.json byte for byte (verified 2026-10-23).

extraction_history.reason: Direct download + parse; source workbook archived 2026-10-23

scope.notes: No cross-framework mappings exist for 4.1.0. The workbook's Scope Applicability (Mappings) sheet holds a single cell: "This dataset is not available yet". The first CCM v4.1 mappings shipped in 4.1.1.

notes: Superseded by ../4.1.1/. The CAIQ questions that shipped with this release are embedded in ccm-4.1.0.json (caiq_questions). The standalone questionnaire under ../../ccm-caiq/4.1.0/ is now the 2026-10-02 generation, built from CCM 4.1.1; the 2026-01-13 extraction that paired with this release is in git at 74ff4b8.

desired_end_state.notes: 207 controls with guidelines and embedded CAIQ questions. Reproducible via scripts/parse_ccm.py.
